Phase 1 — Foundation & Test Structure | Site: SauceDemo

As a QA learner, I want to automate the successful login flow on SauceDemo so that I can verify standard credentials grant access to the inventory page.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1: A test file login.cy.ts exists in cypress/e2e with a describe and at least one it block.

AC2: The test calls cy.visit('/') to navigate to the SauceDemo login page.

AC3: cy.get('[data-test="username"]') and cy.get('[data-test="password"]') are used with .type() to enter credentials standard_user / secret_sauce.

AC4: .click() is called on the login button.

AC5: A cy.url().should('include', 'inventory') assertion passes, confirming successful login redirects to the inventory page.

AC6: Test passes in the Cypress Test Runner.

## Learning Goal
Grasp the fundamental structure of a Cypress test and basic DOM interactions.

## References
- Site: https://www.saucedemo.com/
